### 🚗 How the “Lock Doors & Start Engine” Sequence Works

| Step | What Happens | Why It Matters |
|------|--------------|----------------|
| **1️⃣ Lock All Doors** | The `lockDoors` command is sent with `unlock: false` and all four doors (`driver`, `passenger`, `rear_left`, `rear_right`). | Keeps the vehicle secure and prevents accidental entry while you’re preparing to drive. |
| **2️⃣ Press the Brake Pedal** | The `pressBrakePedal` command is issued with `pedalPosition: 1.0` (fully pressed). | Modern EVs require the brake pedal to be fully engaged before the engine (or motor) can start, ensuring safety and preventing unintended movement. |
| **3️⃣ Start the Engine** | The `startEngine` command is sent with `ignitionMode: "START"`. | Powers up the electric drivetrain, enabling the vehicle to move once you release the brake. |

> **Safety Note:**  
> • Always keep the brake pedal pressed until the engine is fully running.  
> • Once the engine is on, you can release the brake and engage the accelerator to begin your journey.
